question: 15. Does ____________ try to copy what you do?

ask_yes_followup.text: Please give me an example of something he/she would try to copy. (If parent does not give one of the following 0 examples, ask each individually.)

evaluate_behaviors.instruction: Does your child try to copy you if you...
items: Put your fingers to your lips to signal "Shhh"?
